ollama.description: Local Ollama LLM inference (OpenAI-compat). Use to run qwen2.5:14b, qwen2.5-coder:14b, deepseek-r1:14b, llama3.2:3b, llava:13b for text/vision/embeddings.

ntfy.description: Push notifications to the operator's phone via local ntfy. Topics: system, security, backup, news, finance, personal.

home-assistant.description: Home Assistant REST API — read sensors, fire scripts, list entities. Needs a long-lived access token; put it in ~/.config/claude/ha-token.

immich.description: Immich photo library — semantic search across photos by description, browse people/places/dates. Needs API key from Immich UI → Account Settings → API Keys.

qdrant.description: Qdrant vector store — semantic search across paperless, karakeep, memos collections indexed by agent-rag-indexer.

vikunja.description: Vikunja tasks + projects — list/create/update tasks, projects, labels, filters. Needs API token from Vikunja UI → Settings → API Tokens.

miniflux.description: Miniflux RSS reader — feeds, categories, unread/starred entries. Needs API key from Miniflux UI → Settings → API Keys.

paperless.description: Paperless-ngx document archive — search OCR'd docs, download PDFs, tag/correspondent management. Needs API token from Paperless UI.

karakeep.description: Karakeep bookmarks + read-later + notes with tags. Needs API token from Karakeep UI → Settings.
